Evidence before you build the wrong thing.

Bring a real question. RAPID helps you scope it, reach people who face it and read the evidence without handling all the outreach yourself.

Request a test
I want to be a tester

No pricing or payment step on this site. The team confirms scope and cost before recruitment.

How a RAPID test works
What a test is

A test is a scoped question with a defined audience and a short task. It is not a focus group or a generic survey. You get evidence about what people actually did.

The process

You send a request. The team scopes the question, audience, terms and reward with you. Matched testers are invited, responses are reviewed, and findings are published only after that review.

What you receive

Recruitment counts with denominators, outcomes and anonymised quotes where consent was given, published findings, and a place to record your build, iterate or pivot decision.

Timing and cost

Timing depends on who qualifies and is agreed during scoping. There is no pricing or payment step on this site; the team confirms any cost before recruitment.

THE HONESTY RULE

Recruitment counts are real queries. Findings state what the test cannot prove. Empty dashboards say they are empty. Matching is team-assisted, so a request does not guarantee the number of testers you hoped for.
